children: UY Scuti Acquisition advanced its planned business combination with Isdera Group by executing two material agreements on Sep 22 2026. A Joinder Agreement added Isdera Inc (Purchaser) and Isdera Technology Limited (Merger Sub) as parties to the existing merger pact, formalizing the transaction structure. Concurrently, a First Amendment to the Agreement and Plan of Merger set the Company Net Value at $920 million, corrected a technical definition, and updated allocation schedules and share capital representations. Together, these actions are intended to streamline closing mechanics and align shareholder allocations as the deal progresses.
